lines.five: Five people, working on the track. They can't hear it coming.
lines.one: On the side track, just one.
lines.pulled_1: You pulled the lever. The five are safe.
lines.pulled_2: But the one on the side track was never in danger, until you moved the trolley.
lines.stayed_1: You left the lever alone. The trolley stayed on its track.
lines.stayed_2: You didn't make this happen. But you could have changed it.
lines.again_same: The same choice again. It seems clear to you.
lines.again_diff: This time you chose the other way. Most people feel the pull of both.
lines.twist_1: A third track. At the end of it, another lever.
lines.twist_2: Pull that one, and the trolley comes for you instead. Would you? If not, is it fair to send it to someone else?
lines.leave: Go again, or step back through the frame.
lines.self_end: The five are safe. So is the one. You chose yourself.
lines.end: Whatever you choose, someone is standing on the track. You only decide who.
lines.driver: The driver has fainted. He'll wake up later with no idea any of this happened.
lines.wavered: You pulled the lever, then put it back. The trolley stayed on its track.
lines.stood_end: You didn't pull anything. You stood with them, and the trolley took you all.
